/-- `depend` as a relation (MM-03.3 §3, O5). -/
def DependStep (q x : Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
  Guarded (DependPre s q x) (dependEff s q x)

/-! ## O6 `enterFrame` (MM-03.3 §4, A5) -/

/-- Owner of the local of index `i` of `ls` (parent, owning local, kind) in the new frame `f`:
the owning local if any, the new frame otherwise (A5). -/
def localOwner (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) (f i : Nat) : Holder :=
  match (ls[i]?).bind (·.2.1) with
  | some o => .place o
  | none => .frame f

/-- Places after `enterFrame`: the locals `ls` appended, owned by the new frame `nF` or by an
earlier local (A5). -/
def enterP (s : S3) (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) : List Place :=
  s.P ++ (List.range ls.length).map fun i =>
    ⟨(ls[i]?).bind (·.1), localOwner ls s.nF i, ((ls[i]?).map (·.2.2)).getD 0⟩

/-- Indices, relative to `ls`, of the root locals (no parent). -/
def rootIdx (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) : List Nat :=
  (List.range ls.length).filter fun i => ((ls[i]?).bind (·.1)).isNone

/-- Effect of `enterFrame` (MM-03.3 §4, O6) with parameters `ps` and locals `ls`: new frame
`nF` pushed; the parameters, derived by the caller, are now held by the new frame (A3); locals
appended, uninitialised, without dependency, alive and unpinned; one active root `Modify`
authority per root local on its footprint, held by the owner of the local (pass-1
arbitrage 2; A4). -/
def enterEff (s : S3) (ps : List Nat) (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) : S3 :=
  { F := s.nF :: s.F, nF := s.nF + 1, P := enterP s ls
    I := fun l => if s.P.length ≤ l then .uninit else s.I l
    A := mapI (fun j y => if j ∈ ps then { y with holder := .frame s.nF } else y) 0 s.A ++
      (rootIdx ls).map fun i =>
      ⟨.modify, none, footprint (enterP s ls) (s.P.length + i), localOwner ls s.nF i, true⟩
    D := fun q => if s.P.length ≤ q then [] else s.D q
    dead := fun q => if s.P.length ≤ q then false else s.dead q
    freed := fun q => if s.P.length ≤ q then false else s.freed q
    pin := fun q => if s.P.length ≤ q then false else s.pin q }

/-- Preconditions of `enterFrame` (MM-03.3 §4, O6): the calling frame is active (non-empty
stack); each parameter is an active authority derived by the caller and held by it (A3); the
parent and the owner of a local are earlier locals; a part has the owner of its
parent. -/
def EnterPre (s : S3) (ps : List Nat) (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) : Prop :=
  s.F ≠ [] ∧

/-- Owner of the element of index `i` of a shape `ls` (A5; C6): its owning element if any, `hd`
otherwise. The owner of a local of `enterFrame` is the case `hd = .frame f` (`localOwner`). -/
def shapeOwner (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) (hd : Holder) (i : Nat) : Holder :=
  match (ls[i]?).bind (·.2.1) with
  | some o => .place o
  | none => hd

/-- Places `P` followed by the elements of the shape `ls` (C6: the encoding of the locals of
`enterFrame`, an indexed forest of (parent, owning element, kind)); the elements without owning
element are owned by `hd` (A5). -/
def shapeP (P : List Place) (hd : Holder) (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) :
    List Place :=
  P ++ (List.range ls.length).map fun i =>
    ⟨(ls[i]?).bind (·.1), shapeOwner ls hd i, ((ls[i]?).map (·.2.2)).getD 0⟩

/-- `enterFrame` lays out its locals as a shape (C6). -/
theorem enterP_eq_shapeP (s : S3) (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) :
    enterP s ls = shapeP s.P (.frame s.nF) ls := rfl

/-- Well-formed shape at offset `n` (MM-03.3 §4, O6; C6): the parent and the owning element of an
element are earlier elements, and a part has the owning element of its parent. It is the clause
of `EnterPre` on the locals (`enterPre_shapeOK`). -/
def ShapeOK (n : Nat) (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) : Prop :=
  ∀ i ∈ List.range ls.length,
    OptP ((ls[i]?).bind (·.1)) (fun r => n ≤ r ∧ r < n + i ∧
      (ls[i]?).bind (·.2.1) = (ls[r - n]?).bind (·.2.1)) True ∧
    OptP ((ls[i]?).bind (·.2.1)) (fun o => n ≤ o ∧ o < n + i) True

instance (n : Nat) (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) : Decidable (ShapeOK n ls) := by
  unfold ShapeOK; infer_instance

theorem enterPre_shapeOK {s : S3} {ps : List Nat} {ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)}
    (h : EnterPre s ps ls) : ShapeOK s.P.length ls := h.2.2

/-- Static preconditions of `alloc provider owner shape` (B5; C6): the allocator value at
`provider` is usable, with the right to update its metadata; the place `owner`, which receives
the ownership, is usable, with exercisable `Modify`; the leaves of the provider are `Init`; the
shape is well-formed. -/
def AllocStatic (k : K) (s : S3) (provider owner : Nat)
    (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) : Prop :=
  s.Usable provider ∧ ProviderRight k s provider ∧ s.Usable owner ∧ HasRight s .modify owner ∧
    (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P provider, s.I l = .init) ∧ ShapeOK s.P.length ls

instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.SharedMutable] (s : S3) (provider owner : Nat)
    (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) : Decidable (AllocStatic k s provider owner ls) := by
  unfold AllocStatic; infer_instance

/-- Places after `alloc` (B5; C6): the elements of the shape appended, those without owning
element owned by `owner`. -/
def allocP (s : S3) (owner : Nat) (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) : List Place :=
  shapeP s.P (.place owner) ls

/-- Effect of `alloc provider owner shape` (B5; C6): the elements of the shape appended as places
of fresh identities, `Uninit`, without anchor, alive, not freed, not pinned; one root authority
`Modify` per root element, on its footprint, held by the owner of the element (A4); the metadata
of the provider, its leaves, set to `Init`. The shape is abstract: it fixes neither alignment nor
layout (milestone 2). -/
def allocEff (s : S3) (provider owner : Nat) (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) : S3 :=
  { s with
    P := allocP s owner ls
    I := fun l => if s.P.length ≤ l then .uninit
      else if l ∈ footprint s.P provider then .init else s.I l
    A := s.A ++ (rootIdx ls).map fun i =>
      ⟨.modify, none, footprint (allocP s owner ls) (s.P.length + i),
        shapeOwner ls (.place owner) i, true⟩
    D := fun q => if s.P.length ≤ q then [] else s.D q
    dead := fun q => if s.P.length ≤ q then false else s.dead q
/-! ## Reachability (MM-03.3 §10) -/

/-- States reached from the initial state (one frame, no place) by `ok` transitions of the
kernel operations, for fixed contracts `k` (MM-03.3.8). -/
inductive Reachable (k : K) : S3 → Prop where
  | init : Reachable k S3.init
  | derive {s s' : S3} {src q : Nat} {m : Mode} :
      Reachable k s → DeriveStep src q m s (.ok s') → Reachable k s'
  | split {s s' : S3} {src : Nat} {rs : List (List Nat)} :
      Reachable k s → SplitStep k src rs s (.ok s') → Reachable k s'
  | release {s s' : S3} {a : Nat} : Reachable k s → ReleaseStep a s (.ok s') → Reachable k s'
  | transfer {s s' : S3} {src dst : Nat} :
      Reachable k s → TransferStep k src dst s (.ok s') → Reachable k s'
  | depend {s s' : S3} {q x : Nat} : Reachable k s → DependStep q x s (.ok s') → Reachable k s'
  | enter {s s' : S3} {ps : List Nat} {ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)} :
      Reachable k s → EnterStep ps ls s (.ok s') → Reachable k s'
  | exit {s s' : S3} : Reachable k s → ExitStep k s (.ok s') → Reachable k s'
  | read {s s' : S3} {a : Nat} {ls : List Nat} :
      Reachable k s → Read3Step a ls s (.ok s') → Reachable k s'
  | write {s s' : S3} {a : Nat} {ls : List Nat} :
      Reachable k s → Write3Step a ls s (.ok s') → Reachable k s'
  | writeShared {s s' : S3} {a : Nat} {ls : List Nat} :
      Reachable k s → WriteSharedStep k a ls s (.ok s') → Reachable k s'
  | pin {s s' : S3} {p : Nat} : Reachable k s → PinStep p s (.ok s') → Reachable k s'
  | unpin {s s' : S3} {p : Nat} : Reachable k s → UnpinStep k p s (.ok s') → Reachable k s'
  | endUse {s s' : S3} {p : Nat} : Reachable k s → EndUseStep k p s (.ok s') → Reachable k s'
  | free {s s' : S3} {p auth : Nat} :
      Reachable k s → FreeStep k p auth s (.ok s') → Reachable k s'

/-- Effect of `transfer(source, destination)` (MM-03.3 §3, O4; A4; A5): the destination becomes
`Init`, the source `Moved`; the anchors of the source, inherited ones included, join those of
the destination and leave the source and its parts; every authority held by the source or one
of its parts is now held by the destination (A4); every place owned by the source or one of its
parts is now owned by the destination, without moving (A5). -/
def transferEff (s : S3) (src dst : Nat) : S3 :=
  { s with
    P := s.P.map fun pl => if heldIn s.P src pl.owner then { pl with owner := .place dst } else pl
    I := fun l => if l ∈ footprint s.P dst then .init
      else if l ∈ footprint s.P src then .moved else s.I l
    D := fun q => if q = dst then s.D dst ++ depsOf s src
      else if partOf s.P q src then [] else s.D q
    A := s.A.map fun y => if heldIn s.P src y.holder then { y with holder := .place dst } else y }

/-- Active derived access covering a leaf of the source and not moved with it
(MM-03.3 §3, O4.4; A4). -/
def ActiveDerivedOutside (s : S3) (src j : Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (s.A[j]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ y.origin ≠ none ∧ ¬ heldIn s.P src y.holder ∧
    ∃ l ∈ y.footprint, l ∈ footprint s.P src) False

instance (s : S3) (src j : Nat) : Decidable (ActiveDerivedOutside s src j) := by
  unfold ActiveDerivedOutside; infer_instance

/-- Place `q` is owned by `src` or one of its parts, directly or through other owned places,
/-- Effect of `depend(result, anchor)` (MM-03.3 §3, O5): the anchor joins the dependencies of
the result place; existing dependencies are kept; propagation to containing values is computed
by `depsOf`. -/

\[
S_3=(F,P,I,A,D,M)
\]

Les règles applicables sont paramétrées par un contrat externe `K`.

### MM-03.3.1 — Cadres `F`

`F` est une pile de cadres d'exécution.

Un cadre possède :

- Une identité.
- Un cadre parent, sauf pour le cadre initial.
- Un ensemble d'emplacements locaux.
- Un ensemble d'autorités créées ou détenues dans ce cadre.

La relation `ancestor(f₁, f₂)` indique que `f₁` est le cadre `f₂` lui-même ou l'un de ses ancêtres.

Un emplacement local ne peut être utilisé après la sortie de son cadre, sauf si une valeur transférable a été légalement déplacée vers une destination plus durable.

Un accès temporaire ne peut être prolongé simplement en le stockant dans un cadre plus ancien.

Les cadres sont des entités sémantiques ; ils n'imposent aucune structure de suivi supplémentaire à l'exécution.

### MM-03.3.2 — Emplacements `P`
Le modèle ne fixe pas :

- La syntaxe des paramètres ou des valeurs non échappantes.
- Les annotations de dépendance dans les signatures publiques.
- Les règles complètes des types génériques.
- La suspension asynchrone.
- Les destructeurs et le nettoyage différé.
- Les handles persistants et leurs protocoles de résolution.
- La politique générale des globales mutables.
- La sémantique concurrente.
- Le raffinement complet vers MM-02.

La seconde classe enrichie des dépendances de non-échappement sera rejetée comme mécanisme principal si les cas courants nécessitent une analyse globale coûteuse, un runtime obligatoire, des copies profondes implicites ou un usage systématique d'opérations non sûres.

L'exactitude des preuves Lean est nécessaire, mais ne suffit pas à établir les performances de compilation ou l'ergonomie d'ERN.

findings.evidence: StaticPinnedBottom k s := ∀ l, k.Pinned l → ∃ q, l ∈ footprint s.P q ∧ OwnedByFrame s.P (s.F.getLastD 0) q. In the model the base frame is always frame 0 of S3.init, and no place is ever owned by it. S3.init has P = []. enterEff gives each local the owner localOwner ls s.nF i, which is .frame s.nF (s.nF ≥ 1) or a place. allocP and transferEff only assign .place owners. exitEff never pops frame 0, since ExitPre requires F₀ ≠ []. I proved this in Lean, checked with `lake env lean`, axioms [propext, Quot.sound] only. File: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-guygouri-Devlab-ernlang-ern/c986905c-e900-4fd9-bebc-4a3ce7ebb180/scratchpad/rev8/lensC345/vacuous.lean. It proves `theorem staticPinnedBottom_forces_empty {k : K} {s : S3} (hr : Reachable k s) (hsp : StaticPinnedBottom k s) : ∀ l, ¬ k.Pinned l`, via `reach_base : Reachable k s → s.F.getLast? = some 0 ∧ 0 < s.nF ∧ ∀ pl ∈ s.P, pl.owner ≠ .frame 0`. So on reachable states the hypothesis holds only for an empty static pinning, and the conclusion `¬ k.Pinned l` then follows trivially. The theorem has content only on hand-built WF3 states that no kernel run reaches. Reading 'cadre de base' as the first entered frame does not help: it makes the theorem false, because that frame can exit. The case KD0 accepts `ExitStep KD0 (pinEff (pinEff c13a 0 true) 0 false) (.ok …)` with c13a.F = [1, 0]. The spec gives the initial frame its own locals (MM-03.3.1: "Un cadre possède : … Un ensemble d'emplacements locaux"), but the model's initial frame has none. The commit message and docstrings do not report this, and no p4 report exists yet.
findings.suggested_fix: Do not change the theorem. Report in (n)2 that on reachable states StaticPinnedBottom is equivalent to K.Pinned = ∅ (citing the lemma above), and ask for an arbitrage. Options: let the base frame own places (locals of the initial frame), or restate the obligation against a frame that can own places and never exits.

Its docstring cites only A6: "The value at `p` ends (A6) … the places owned by `p` or one of its parts are logically dead." endUseEff also cites only A6. In the model the base frame is always frame 0 of S3.init, and no place is ever owned by it. S3.init has P = []. enterEff gives each local the owner localOwner ls s.nF i, which is .frame s.nF (s.nF ≥ 1) or a place. allocP and transferEff only assign .place owners. exitEff never pops frame 0, since ExitPre requires F₀ ≠ []. I proved this in Lean, checked with `lake env lean`, axioms [propext, Quot.sound] only. File: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-guygouri-Devlab-ernlang-ern/c986905c-e900-4fd9-bebc-4a3ce7ebb180/scratchpad/rev8/lensC345/vacuous.lean. It proves `theorem staticPinnedBottom_forces_empty {k : K} {s : S3} (hr : Reachable k s) (hsp : StaticPinnedBottom k s) : ∀ l, ¬ k.Pinned l`, via `reach_base : Reachable k s → s.F.getLast? = some 0 ∧ 0 < s.nF ∧ ∀ pl ∈ s.P, pl.owner ≠ .frame 0`. So on reachable states the hypothesis holds only for an empty static pinning, and the conclusion `¬ k.Pinned l` then follows trivially. The theorem has content only on hand-built WF3 states that no kernel run reaches. Reading 'cadre de base' as the first entered frame does not help: it makes the theorem false, because that frame can exit. The case KD0 accepts `ExitStep KD0 (pinEff (pinEff c13a 0 true) 0 false) (.ok …)` with c13a.F = [1, 0]. The spec gives the initial frame its own locals (MM-03.3.1: "Un cadre possède : … Un ensemble d'emplacements locaux"), but the model's initial frame has none. The commit message and docstrings do not report this, and no p4 report exists yet.
findings.suggested_fix: Do not change the theorem. Report in (n)2 that on reachable states StaticPinnedBottom is equivalent to K.Pinned = ∅ (citing the lemma above), and ask for an arbitrage. Options: let the base frame own places (locals of the initial frame), or restate the obligation against a frame that can own places and never exits.

findings.title: C8 is cited on the precondition EndUsePre, not on the effect endUseS/endUseEff that encodes it
findings.evidence: C8 (task_mm03_p4.md) is about the effect: "`endUse p` laisse `p` lui-même utilisable, feuilles `Uninit` … Seuls les emplacements possédés par `p` deviennent logiquement morts." endUseS encodes it (I := … .uninit on footprint p; dead set only for places with heldIn s.P p pl.owner). Its docstring cites only A6: "The value at `p` ends (A6) … the places owned by `p` or one of its parts are logically dead." endUseEff also cites only A6. The only C8 citation is in the EndUsePre docstring ("C8: `p` itself stays usable, its leaves `Uninit`."), and nothing in EndUsePre's body encodes it. AGENTS.md: "Every definition or theorem that encodes a spec rule cites the rule's location in its docstring." The behaviour itself is correct: I checked by `#eval` that `(endUseEff n6a 0).Usable 0 = true`, `(endUseEff n6a 0).Usable 2 = false`, and that endUse of storage 2 after unpin leaves 2 usable.
findings.suggested_fix: Move the C8 sentence from the EndUsePre docstring to the endUseS (or endUseEff) docstring.
